description: The primorial of n, the product of the primes less than or equal to n. The primorial of 1 is 1, of 10 is 210, and of 11 is 2310. n runs from 1 to 5000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/primorial
